text:
Harper: Heads-up—visitor from SoundWorks arriving ~2:15pm with an oversized rolled poster + an acoustic guitar case. Might need dolly and a temp badge. Can we save the green lobby chair near the planters for them while they sign in? :guitar: :frame_photo: :chair:
FrontDeskBot: Delivery logged: 1x rolled poster (SoundWorks), 1x guitar case (guest: Zoe). Location: Receiving A. Temp badge color: orange. Dolly available on request.
Zoe: I'll be the guest. Thanks for flagging—happy to meet at concierge. Can someone save the green chair 2:10-2:30? I need a seat to tune the guitar.
Theo: :thumbsup: saving green chair 2:10-2:30. I'll move my stuff. Also Facilities can bring a small dolly if the poster crate is heavy.
Ava: FYI there's a tote in Mailroom 1 labeled "SoundWorks - pickup" I put a sticky note on it. Might be related.
Harper: Good catch. I'll check with FrontDesk before moving anything. Harper: Quick poll—react :thumbsup: to hold the green chair, :thumbsdown: if you need it.
Theo: :thumbsup:
FrontDeskBot: Visitor checklist: 1) ID scan on arrival; 2) orange temp badge printed + handwritten name; 3) sign visitor log; 4) escort option to the small meeting alcove if needed. Dolly requested: Facilities ETA 2:05.
Zoe: Appreciate the dolly. I'll bring a towel for the guitar and a dust cover for the poster.
Ava: If the poster is too big for the lobby, CR1 (near cafe) is free 2:15-3:00 and has flat space.
Harper: Noted—I'll reserve CR1 as backup. If green chair is used, please move Theo's stuff to the small bench.
Theo: Done. Bench cleared.
FrontDeskBot: Temp badge color set to orange; delivery flagged "fragile; guitar case"; mailroom tote noted in delivery log.
Zoe: I'll be at concierge 2:10 and can escort to CR1 or the green chair depending on space. Thanks everyone :smile:
Harper: Thanks all. Ping here if plans change.
_meta: watercooler thread coordinating visitor with guitar and oversized poster, temp badging, seating reservation, mailroom tote, and dolly request
